templates.pat: Resources are assigned one or more {{1}} from the {{2}}. EDAM (Ison {{3}} 2013 ; Black {{4}} 2022) is a domain ontology of data analysis and data management in bio- and other sciences, and science-based applications. Targeting usability by diverse users, the structure of EDAM is relatively simple, divided into 4 main sections: Topic, Operation, Data (incl. Identifier), and Format.
templates.zh: 资源会从{{2}}中分配一个或多个{{1}}。EDAM（Ison {{3}} 2013；Black {{4}} 2022）是一个描述生物科学及其他科学中的数据分析与数据管理、以及基于科学的应用的领域本体。为便于不同用户使用，EDAM 的结构相对简单，分为 4 个主部分：主题（Topic）、操作（Operation）、数据（Data，含标识符）与格式（Format）。

templates.pat: The EDAM Operation terms are displayed in the section entitled {{1}}, while the other EDAM terms are displayed in the section {{2}}. Note that EDAM topic terms which correspond to a category are excluded.

templates.pat: Expasy is the {{1}} registry of bioinformatics software tools, database/knowledgebase resources, and data sets developed by SIB members. It provides detailed information about software tools, databases and data sets that support a range of life science and clinical research domains, from genomics, proteomics and structural biology, to evolution and phylogeny, systems biology and medical chemistry.
templates.zh: Expasy 是 {{1}} 的生物信息学软件工具、数据库/知识库资源与数据集的登记目录，这些资源均由 SIB 成员开发。它提供软件工具、数据库与数据集的详细信息，覆盖从基因组学、蛋白质组学与结构生物学，到进化与系统发育、系统生物学与药物化学等一系列生命科学与临床研究领域。

templates.pat: Expasy was created in August 1993, at the dawn of the internet era, by two SIB-cofounders {{1}} and {{2}} At the time, it was referred to as 'ExPASy, the Expert Protein Analysis System' as proteins were its primary focus. It was the first life science website - and among the 150 very first websites in the world!
templates.zh: Expasy 于 1993 年 8 月、互联网时代初期由两位 SIB 联合创始人 {{1}} 和 {{2}} 创建。当时它被称为「ExPASy，Expert Protein Analysis System」，因为蛋白质是其关注重点。它是第一个生命科学网站，也是全球最早的 150 个网站之一！

templates.pat: The registry content is freely available to all under the Creative Commons Attribution licence ({{1}}). Please ensure appropriate credit by citing our reference publication.
